title: Proverbs Chapter 24 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 24 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 24 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 24.

questions.question: In Proverbs 24, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Be not thou envious against evil men
Through wisdom is an house builded
If thou faint in the day of adversity
questions.correctAnswer: Be not thou envious against evil men
questions.explanation: This is the first statement in Proverbs 24, found in Proverbs 24:1.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:2 state about the heart of evil men?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:2 specifically states that 'For their heart studieth destruction.'

questions.question: According to Proverbs 24:3, what is through wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:3 states that 'Through wisdom is an house builded.'

questions.question: What fills the chambers according to Proverbs 24:4?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:4 says 'And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.'

questions.question: What does a wise man increase according to Proverbs 24:5?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:5 states 'a man of knowledge increaseth strength.'

questions.question: What is there in multitude of counsellors according to Proverbs 24:6?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:6 states 'and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.'

questions.question: Who does wisdom not benefit according to Proverbs 24:7?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:7 states 'Wisdom is too high for a fool.'

questions.question: What shall the person who devises to do evil be called according to Proverbs 24:8?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:8 states 'He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.'

questions.question: What is the thought of foolishness according to Proverbs 24:9?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:9 states 'The thought of foolishness is sin.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:10 say about strength in adversity?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:10 states 'If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.'

questions.question: According to Proverbs 24:11, who should be delivered?
options: Those that are drawn unto death
questions.correctAnswer: Those that are drawn unto death
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:11 states 'If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death...'

questions.question: Does God consider the heart according to Proverbs 24:12?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:12 states 'doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it?' indicating that God does consider the heart.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 24:12, who knows the soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:12 states 'he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it?' confirming that God knows the soul.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 24:9, the thought of wisdom is sin.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:9 states 'The thought of foolishness is sin', not wisdom.

questions.question: Proverbs 24:6 states that there is safety in a few counsellors.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:6 states 'in multitude of counsellors there is safety', not a few.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 24 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 24 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What should a son eat according to Proverbs 24:13?
questions.explanation: This is correct because Proverbs 24:13 states, 'My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste.'

questions.question: What reward is promised for finding wisdom according to Proverbs 24:14?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:14 states, 'So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward...'

questions.question: What should one not do against the righteous according to Proverbs 24:15?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:15 warns, 'Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:16 say about a just man?
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 24:16, 'For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again...'

questions.question: What should one not do when their enemy stumbles according to Proverbs 24:17?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:17 states, 'Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:18 warn will happen if one rejoices at their enemy's downfall?
options: The LORD will turn away His wrath
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will turn away His wrath
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:18 says, 'Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.'

questions.question: What should one not fret over according to Proverbs 24:19?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:19 advises, 'Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:20 say will happen to the evil man?
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 24:20, 'For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.'

questions.question: What is advised in Proverbs 24:21 regarding the LORD and the king?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:21 states, 'My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:'

questions.question: What calamity is mentioned in Proverbs 24:22?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:22 warns, 'For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:23 say about respect of persons in judgment?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:23 states, 'These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:24 say will happen to those who call the wicked righteous?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:24 states, 'He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him.'

questions.question: Is it advised to envy evil men according to Proverbs 24:1?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:1 explicitly advises, 'Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.'

questions.question: Is it good to have respect of persons in judgment according to Proverbs 24:23?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:23 clearly states that 'It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.'

questions.question: Can the righteous man fall and rise again according to Proverbs 24:16?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:16 confirms that 'For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again,' indicating he can fall and still rise.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 24 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 24.

questions.question: What is promised to those who rebuke the wicked according to Proverbs 24:25?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:25 states that those who rebuke the wicked shall find delight and receive a good blessing, emphasizing the value of righteous correction.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:26 say about giving a right answer?
options: It is wise to avoid answering
Every man shall kiss his lips
It is better to remain silent
questions.correctAnswer: Every man shall kiss his lips
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 24:26, giving a right answer is so valued that it is metaphorically described as worthy of a kiss, indicating appreciation for wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:27 instruct regarding preparation?
options: Prepare work in the field first
questions.correctAnswer: Prepare work in the field first
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:27 instructs to prepare your work in the field before building your house, highlighting the importance of proper preparation and priorities.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 24:28, what is advised about being a witness?
options: Be a witness for the righteous
Witness even if it is unjust
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:28 advises against being a witness against your neighbor without cause, emphasizing the moral obligation to uphold justice.

questions.question: What warning is given in Proverbs 24:29 regarding revenge?
options: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me
questions.correctAnswer: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:29 warns against the desire for revenge, instructing not to retaliate as others have wronged you, promoting forgiveness and moral integrity.

questions.question: What is observed about the field of the slothful in Proverbs 24:30?
options: It has a strong stone wall
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:30 describes the field of the slothful as overgrown with thorns, illustrating the consequences of laziness and neglect.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'slothful' in Proverbs 24:30 imply?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for 'slothful' implies a state of laziness and idleness, contrasting with the diligent worker who thrives.

questions.question: Which literary technique is used in Proverbs 24:33 with the phrase 'a little sleep, a little slumber'?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:33 employs parallelism, where similar ideas are expressed in a rhythmic structure, emphasizing the theme of slothfulness.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of laziness in Proverbs 24:30?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:24 echoes the theme of laziness by contrasting the diligent with the slothful, aligning with the observations made in Proverbs 24:30.

questions.question: Which verse in the New Testament fulfills the concept of rendering to each according to their works as seen in Proverbs 24:29?
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:7 parallels Proverbs 24:29 by teaching that a man reaps what he sows, reinforcing the principle of accountability for actions.

questions.question: What comes before Proverbs 24:30?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:29 precedes verse 30, discussing the principle of not seeking revenge, leading into the observation of slothfulness in verse 30.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24:34 predict as a consequence of slothfulness?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:34 indicates that poverty will come as a traveler to the slothful, illustrating the inevitability of consequences for laziness.

questions.question: The statement 'a just man falleth seven times' in Proverbs 24:16 indicates what moral lesson?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:16 teaches that a just man will rise again after falling, emphasizing the importance of perseverance in moral integrity.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 24:22 warns against associating with those who change.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:22 warns against meddling with those who are given to change, emphasizing the need for stability in relationships.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 24:20 assures that there will be rewards for the wicked.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:20 states that there shall be no reward for the evil man, highlighting the certainty of divine justice.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 24 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 24 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Proverbs 24:3 teach about the role of wisdom in human life?
options: Wisdom is foundational for building and establishing a household
Wisdom guarantees material wealth without effort
Wisdom is only important for spiritual leaders
Wisdom replaces the need for hard work
questions.correctAnswer: Wisdom is foundational for building and establishing a household
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:3 states, 'Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established,' teaching that wisdom is essential for the foundation and establishment of a stable home, highlighting its practical and foundational role.

questions.question: What doctrine about human sin does Proverbs 24:9 teach?
options: Foolish thoughts themselves are sinful and scorners are detestable to others
Sin is only found in actions, not thoughts
The scorner is a respected figure among men
Foolishness is excused if it is unintentional
questions.correctAnswer: Foolish thoughts themselves are sinful and scorners are detestable to others
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:9 says, 'The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men,' indicating that sinful nature includes foolish thoughts, and that scorners are abhorred socially, emphasizing the seriousness of sin beyond external acts.

questions.question: What doctrine does Proverbs 24:16 teach about perseverance and divine justice?
options: The righteous may fall repeatedly but will rise again; the wicked ultimately face ruin
The righteous never face failure or hardship
The wicked are stronger than the righteous
Falling means one is permanently rejected by God
questions.correctAnswer: The righteous may fall repeatedly but will rise again; the wicked ultimately face ruin
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:16 states, 'For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief,' teaching perseverance in righteousness and final judgment on the wicked.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Proverbs 24:12 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:12 highlights God's complete knowledge of human hearts and deeds: 'he that pondereth the heart considereth it; and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it?' This shows God's attribute of omniscience.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is exemplified in Proverbs 24:18 regarding God's response to human attitudes toward enemies?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:18 says that God may turn away His wrath if He sees a heart not rejoicing over an enemy's fall, indicating His longsuffering patience and restraint in judgment.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 24:6 prepare for New Testament teaching on counsel and unity in the church?
options: By teaching that wise counsel and many advisers bring safety, it anticipates the NT emphasis on communal discernment
By rejecting counsel entirely in favor of individual wisdom
By focusing only on military strategy
By promoting isolation from others in decision-making
questions.correctAnswer: By teaching that wise counsel and many advisers bring safety, it anticipates the NT emphasis on communal discernment
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:6 advises using wise counsel and many counselors for safety, prefiguring NT teachings such as in Acts 15 about the value of collective wisdom and unity in the church.

questions.question: In what way does Proverbs 24:13–14 connect to the theme of eternal reward in the New Testament?
options: It teaches that gaining wisdom results in a reward and fulfilled expectation, echoing NT promises of eternal life
It promises immediate earthly riches to all who seek wisdom
It denies any reward for the wise
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches that gaining wisdom results in a reward and fulfilled expectation, echoing NT promises of eternal life
questions.explanation: Verses 13–14 speak of the reward and uncut expectation that comes from acquiring wisdom, paralleling NT doctrines about the eternal reward for the wise and faithful (e.g., Matthew 5:5).

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Proverbs 24:11 and 24:12 teach about human responsibility and divine judgment?
options: Humans are morally responsible to rescue the perishing and cannot claim ignorance before God who judges hearts
Human rescue efforts are irrelevant to salvation
Ignorance is a valid excuse before God
questions.correctAnswer: Humans are morally responsible to rescue the perishing and cannot claim ignorance before God who judges hearts
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:11 commands delivering those drawn to death, and 24:12 states God knows the heart and will judge accordingly, together teaching accountability before an omniscient God.

questions.question: What doctrine about impartiality in judgment do Proverbs 24:23 and 24:24 jointly teach?
options: Judges must not show partiality or declare the wicked righteous, lest they bring curse upon themselves
Judges should favor the rich for stability
Judgment should be based on popularity
Partiality is encouraged to maintain order
questions.correctAnswer: Judges must not show partiality or declare the wicked righteous, lest they bring curse upon themselves
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:23 warns against respect of persons in judgment, and 24:24 condemns calling the wicked righteous, teaching the necessity of impartial and righteous judgment.

questions.question: How do Proverbs 24:27 and 24:30-31 synthesize a doctrine about wise preparation and the consequences of neglect?
options: Wise preparation in work leads to stability, while neglect results in ruin and loss
Preparation is unnecessary if God wills prosperity
Neglect is a sign of divine favor
Work has no impact on one’s future
questions.correctAnswer: Wise preparation in work leads to stability, while neglect results in ruin and loss
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:27 advises preparing work before building a house, while 24:30-31 shows the vineyard of the slothful overgrown and ruined, teaching the importance of diligence.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Proverbs 24:19-20 teaches that evil men prosper and have lasting rewards. What does this passage actually teach?
options: Evil men have no lasting reward; their 'candle' will be extinguished
Evil men are secretly favored by God
Envying evil men is necessary for success
The wicked will ultimately triumph over the righteous
questions.correctAnswer: Evil men have no lasting reward; their 'candle' will be extinguished
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:19-20 warns against envying evil men because their candle will be put out, meaning their success is temporary and they will face judgment.

questions.question: What doctrine about human strength and knowledge is taught in Proverbs 24:5?
options: A wise man gains strength through knowledge, emphasizing the sanctifying power of divine wisdom
Strength is only physical and unrelated to wisdom
Knowledge weakens a man by confusing him
questions.correctAnswer: A wise man gains strength through knowledge, emphasizing the sanctifying power of divine wisdom
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:5 states that a wise man is strong and a man of knowledge increases strength, teaching that wisdom and knowledge empower and strengthen the believer.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Proverbs 24:22 demonstrate concerning the fate of those who oppose established authority?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:22 speaks of sudden calamity rising upon those given to change (rebellion), highlighting God's sovereign control over nations and rulers.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 24:28-29 teach a doctrine consistent with New Testament ethics regarding testimony and retaliation?
options: It forbids false testimony and personal revenge, anticipating NT commands to love enemies
It encourages personal vengeance to maintain justice
It permits lying if justified by circumstances
It allows retaliation equal to the offense
questions.correctAnswer: It forbids false testimony and personal revenge, anticipating NT commands to love enemies
questions.explanation: Verses 28-29 command against false witness and saying 'I will do to him as he hath done to me,' teaching ethical restraint and truthfulness consistent with NT teachings (e.g., Romans 12:17-21).

questions.question: What combined doctrine about discernment and the value of wise speech is taught by Proverbs 24:25-26?
options: Rebuking the wicked brings blessing, and giving a right answer earns respect
Silence is always preferable to rebuke
Wise speech is irrelevant to righteousness
questions.correctAnswer: Rebuking the wicked brings blessing, and giving a right answer earns respect
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:25 says those who rebuke the wicked receive delight and blessing, and 24:26 states that a man who gives a right answer is honored, teaching the value of truthful and wise speech.
